metadata.provenance: First source-controlled visual proposal. No previously accepted Gauge portrait existed on this home branch.

design.concept: An adult-presenting androgynous, non-biographical scientific observer; calm, precise, curious and quietly skeptical.
design.facial_features: Stylized warm-neutral face, direct gaze, subtle half-smile, minimal shading, no distinctive real-person likeness.
design.hair: Close-cropped asymmetrical swept pale silver hair, one slender amber temple stroke on viewer-right.
design.eyepiece: Exactly one circular translucent teal calibration optic positioned over the eye on the viewer-left; no second lens, goggles or visor.
design.clothing: Matte graphite and slate-blue structured field jacket with lapels, pale neutral inset, small amber graduated-calibration clasp.
design.motif: Concentric fine instrument dial rings and restrained tick marks behind the head.
design.style: Crisp vector geometry, reserved gradients, uncluttered silhouette, no text, no brands, no official uniforms.

adaptations.icon: Prioritize one teal optic, silver swept hair and graphite shoulders; remove dial clutter first at tiny sizes.
adaptations.portrait: Keep all signature attributes, gaze and calibration clasp. The SVG master is the default front-facing bust reference.
adaptations.full_body: Extend the understated field jacket to neutral practical attire; retain face, single eyepiece, hair, amber pin.
adaptations.pixel_art: Use same palette and asymmetry in 16-bit-like sprite proportions without inventing a different costume.
adaptations.three_dimensional: Maintain exact number and viewer-side of eyepiece, asymmetrical swept hair and matte materials.
adaptations.monochrome: Encode the unique circular eyepiece and layered jacket as silhouette/shape distinctions.
adaptations.prompt: Gauge — The Witness, adult-presenting androgynous humanlike scientific observer, short swept silver hair with a single amber temple accent, one round teal measuring eyepiece covering the eye on the viewer-left, matte graphite and slate coat with a small amber graduation pin, reserved gentle half-smile, subtle circular instrument dial behind, clean precise geometric illustration.
prohibited: No second eyepiece or two-lens goggles.
Do not replace silver swept hair, teal circle, graphite coat or amber pin.
No military, police, medical, government or religious uniform or credentials.
No weapons, corporate logos, text or watermarks.
Do not portray any real person or claim authenticated agent identity.

continuity.mutation_rule: If owner approval later establishes canon, publish a versioned reference; future adaptations must cite source visual ID and revision rather than silently overwrite historical renders.
